definitionZh: 字体大小- adjust CSS 属性调整字体大小, 以匹配一个选定的字体度量, 如小写字母的高度, 以指定字体大小的比例 。 此属性用于调整倒置字体,使其具有与首选字体相似的度量.
sourceDefinition: The font-size-adjust CSS property adjusts the size of a font to match a chosen font metric, such as the height of lowercase letters, to a specified proportion of the font-size. This property is intended for adjusting fallback fonts to have similar metrics as the first-choice font.
